fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) declined 3% Tuesday morning as Citi cut price target from $315 to $285 while maintaining buy rating, citing margin pressure from high-bandwidth memory price increases.
fields.summary_ko.1: Citi analyst Atif Malik confirmed expectations for 70% annual operating profit growth in FY2028, with visibility on smaller cloud providers' orders and CEO investigation remaining key investor concerns.
